verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware authentication device. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back user-built automations is not a capability this kind of product would ship, so the axis does not apply. The scriptable ykman CLI and the URL-versioned OTP protocol are user-side scripting and API versioning. Neither is a product feature for managing automation versions, so neither makes this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
